NULL GATE A confirms the residual tracks REAL cascade structure: a monofractal/no-intermittency field (sigma~0) collapses the RAW Xi by ~3 orders of magnitude. Kolmogorov K41 is a phenomenological dimensional hypothesis (not a closure of NS); the intermittency corrections (Kolmogorov-Obukhov K62 lognormal, She-Leveque) are MODELS/ansaetze, not derivations -- this is the celebrated, still-open TURBULENCE CLOSURE PROBLEM. A principle that merely NAMES the run (DNS exhibits the exponents) is expected and points to E0, not E2. So no recognition-landing.
